messages:
kai: opened PR to update Meridian-13B model card: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1710. Main items: clarify supported variants (-full, -lite-q4), update seq_limit table, add small streaming example and an embeddings snippet for sharded inference.

emily: thanks. paste current seq_limit row?

kai: here:
```
variant | seq_limit | recommended_shards
meridian-13b-full | 8192 | 1 per 60 QPS
meridian-13b-lite-q4 | 8192 | 1 per 45 QPS
```

sam: nit: append "(measured avg prompt 128 tokens)" to the table footnote. Also add a line about KV cache behavior with very long contexts.

emily: for JS snippet use client.generate.stream async iterator pattern in SDK v3. example here:
```javascript
for await (const part of client.generate.stream({model:'meridian-13b-full', prompt:'Explain...'})) {
  process.stdout.write(part.text)
}
```

sam: added bench link and conservative perf delta for q4 (~18-25%) in PR description: https://bench.redwood/runs/1710-meridian

docs-bot: preview deployed -> https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/docs/model-cards/meridian-13b (status: success) :white_check_mark:

kai: addressed all nits, updated migration note (batch_size -> batchSize) and sharding guide link. merging in 5 unless objections.

emily: approved.

sam: approved.

kai: merged. changelog: "Meridian-13B: clarified variants, seq limits, KV cache note, added SDK v3 streaming and sharded embeddings snippets, linked bench runs."
